text:
Maya Chen: Quick async check — wrapping up the SDK quickstart edits. Most docs updated, sampleapp Dockerfile adjusted, added streaming chat snippet. I'm blocked on npm publish because the org token needs rotation.
Sam Patel: On it, pinged infra for token rotation. Can you drop the PR link?
Maya Chen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex-sdk/pull/412 — main diffs in docs/quickstart.md and examples/sample-app/Dockerfile. Env var note: `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.
Jordan Lee: CI is failing on that PR (macos-latest). Log shows `EACCES` during `npm ci` in sampleapp — looks like permission on lockfile.
Maya Chen: Reproduced locally on BigSur. Trying a fix: remove `--unsafe-perm` and regenerate lockfile.
Alex R.: I'm blocked from landing sampleapp until the new SDK release goes out (semver minor). If token rotation takes >2h can we publish a prerelease?
Sam Patel: We can do a prerelease. I'll coordinate with release infra. @deploy-bot can you kick a canary?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary release queued for devex-sdk@0.9.0-canary.1 — job #2871. Logs: https://ci.redwood/2871
Maya Chen: Nice. Also added a streaming example in the quickstarts — would appreciate a quick docs review on the 'expected latency' table and wording.
Jordan Lee: I'll eyeball it tonight and sanity-check numbers. Also sampleapp tests need a mocked streaming socket; I can add a unit.
Lia Gomez: Left a couple comments on the docs PR about tone and a simpler snippet. Small nit: prefer `await client.generate(...)` over `.then(...)` style.
Maya Chen: Updating now. Quick question: any objections to bumping sampleapp base image to `node:18-slim`?
Alex R.: We discussed — ok to bump. Add a README note for M1 devs: use `--platform=linux/amd64` locally.
Jordan Lee: I'll add a CI job to test `docker build --platform=linux/amd64` on the runner. Current checklist: docs ✅, Dockerfile updated ✅, SDK prerelease ✅, CI fix in-progress.
Maya Chen: Blocker cleared for me once canary is green. I'll merge after CI turns green. Thanks everyone :rocket:
Sam Patel: :thumbsup: I'll follow up on token rotation and confirm when we can promote from prerelease to stable.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary passed for devex-sdk@0.9.0-canary.1 — promoting to staging.
Maya Chen: Awesome — merging now.
Jordan Lee: Quick reminder — add a changelog entry for the quickstart and sampleapp Docker bump (docs/changelog.md). One line about streaming example + node base bump.
Maya Chen: Done, pushed changelog in the same PR.
Lia Gomez: :eyes: checked the new snippet — looks good. Tiny style nit: missing semicolon in the API example.
Maya Chen: Fixed and pushed. Thanks!
